title: Interpolation results properties
description: What the model gave at the k-points it was evaluated at, grouped as the SCF results file groups its own: the Fermi level, the eigenvalues and the density of states, each carrying its unit in its own `units` field.

fermi_energy.description: ESSE's fermi_energy property: the Fermi level the NSCF that built the record computed over its own full-grid k-set, the highest occupied level when every requested band is occupied. q3.workflows.interpolation reports the SCF's value instead, which is the authoritative one.

eigenvalues_at_kpoints.description: ESSE's eigenvalues_at_kpoints record: the interpolated eigenvalues at each evaluated k-point, one entry per k-point with its crystal coordinates and one spin channel, as the SCF results file lists its own, so the Python readers read both the same way; present when bands were evaluated.

density_of_states.description: ESSE's density_of_states record, as it stands: the interpolated density of states on control.interpolation.dos_mesh, broadened by control.dos_broadening; xDataArray the energy grid in xAxis.units, yDataSeries one series of states per that energy unit per cell, spin included. Present when a mesh was asked for.
